text.line: 2.21 It is proposed that our achievements against delivering this objective would be measured by:
The area of and number of people in the 48dB LAeq 6.5hr night contour.
• Number of movements in the night quota period
If applicable, set review date: October 2022

CAA noise analysis identifies the 48dB LAeq, 6.5hr night contour as the region at which night noise could have adverse health effects on populations. It is proposed that this contour is used to measure progress against the proposed environmental objective. ** (Reference: 102)

references.reference: K. Jones, Environmental Research and consultancy Department, CAA. Aircraft Noise and Sleep Disturbance: A Review (2009) https://publicapps.caa.co.uk/docs/33/ERCD0905.pdf
